text:
alex: Heads up — planning to roll out v0.9.3 tomorrow 11:00 PT. Draft internal announcement + release notes below. Please review copy, pinning, and rollback guidance. Need ops sign-off by EOD. @jordan @meera

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy created: 2026-03-21 18:00 UTC (11:00 PT). Canary: 5% -> 30% -> 100%. Rollback image must be available before canary.

maria: Quick copy pass — overall 👍. Suggest we explicitly call out Dedicated customers getting a pinned model during the window.

sam: Q: do we need to mention model pinning for the 13B quantized variant? Some enterprise customers asked about deterministic perf.

jordan: Yes — we'll pin infra -> model `redwood/gpt-13b-q4f3:v2` for the change window. Rollback target = `redwood/gpt-13b-q4f3:v1`. Add that line to the notes.

meera: Ops signoff: verified canary config and rollback image exist in registry. Oncall for window is @ops-oncall. Change window 11:00-13:00 PT.

alex: Updated draft with model pin details and rollback pointer. Also calling out a known short-lived token spike issue that may surface during warmup. Draft below — please flag anything missing.

alex: ```
Release notes (internal) - v0.9.3 - deploy 2026-03-21 11:00 PT

Summary:
- Fix: reduced tail latency for streaming responses on long-context sessions.
- Change: pin `redwood/gpt-13b-q4f3:v2` for Dedicated during 11:00-13:00 PT to ensure deterministic perf.
- Note: temporary token-rate spike may occur during model warmup (~2-5m) affecting billing telemetry; no user-facing failures expected.

Rollback plan:
- If canary error rate > 2% sustained over 5m OR latency P95 increases > 40% from baseline, execute automated rollback to `redwood/gpt-13b-q4f3:v1`.
- Runbook: https://intranet.redwood/runbooks/release-rollbacks

Monitoring:
- Dashboards: infra -> Deploys / Canary Errors / P95 Latency (linked in ops playbook)
- Pager: @ops-oncall (primary) -> escalation to oncall lead
```

jordan: Nit: change "reduced tail latency" -> "fixed regression causing increased tail latency" for accuracy. Also add the runbook link inline like you did.

ops-oncall: I'll prep the dashboards and add the alert thresholds. If canary errors > 2% for 5m, we'll trigger rollback. I'll post the playbook snippets to the thread before handoff. :warning:

alex: Good catch, updated wording. Final quick question — is this internal-only or do we want a short external blurb after metrics check? @maria

maria: Internal only for this deploy. External announcement tentatively next week after metric validation. I'll draft the external blurb separately if metrics look clean. :+1:

deploy-bot: Reminder: deploy scheduled in ~12h. Verify oncall handoff and pinning are set.

alex: Thanks everyone — locking this version of the notes. I'll pin the thread and update the release checklist. If anything changes, call it out here.
